body:
CANONICAL: Greg's continuous-work and handoff direction (Engram::Fable, 2026-10-17; relayed by Engram::Advisor, mailbox-74a6af16). These are Greg's words or the Advisor's restatement of them. They carry no higher authority than his current word, and grant no commit, push, install, restart or authority widening.

#1577 (2026-10-17, Advisor's restatement): work proceeds continuously; avoid idle capacity. A quiet period is acceptable only while another project's active full gate needs it. Every recovered lane has a distinct code, test, review or design action with a NAMED RELEASE CONDITION, or a precise external blocker. Separate worktrees for independent items; Sol 6.1 primarily for coding. No overlapping heavy gates. Don't leave work waiting merely for a coordinator wake. Report active and held lanes, with the next action per lane, at gate boundaries.

#1578: work must not stop until Greg asks for status (proof: the 08:34-15:36Z stall). A P1 host handoff fix (TermAl w-d9f93ea08fd2, a host-local ledger; Engram w-42326 PARKED as not needed). Until it lands: an explicit watchdog over Engram and TermAl gates and carriers.
#1583: classify every idle lane as (a) waiting on a resource window, (b) external decision or (c) dispatchable, wake every (c) at once, and report the active count. Acceptance case on w-d9f9: a status observation must not be needed for the scan to happen.

#1580, Greg VERBATIM: "Pytania do mnie mogą być w fazie projektowej. Nie powinni nigdy blokować pracy." Record each question with its recommended default and continue reversible work on the default where authority permits. An explicit Greg PAUSE or STOP on an item (for example w-46f2, w-e775) is NOT a question and still holds: check item notes before dispatch.

#1592 (2026-10-17 17:44Z, Advisor's restatement): do not spend more capacity attributing the 20 s admission stall with small synthetic benchmarks. Greg directly observes seconds of 100% NVMe and host unresponsiveness. Treat HOST DISK SATURATION as a real operating condition: keep the concrete typed-busy fix (w-b64c), prioritize production-size or host telemetry only when it informs a fix, and SCHEDULE AND BACKPRESSURE heavy work so it doesn't overlap destructively. Continue independent correctness work. Never present a quiet-slot benchmark as evidence that the incident is absent.

HOW ENGRAM::FABLE APPLIES IT:
- Watchdog: a cron tick every 10 min in session-5135 (re-create it after a restart or compaction): unread mail, terminal unrelayed runs, overdue TermAl promises, idle lanes with a met release condition, claim expiry, free disk. Every handoff names its successor and a deadline.
- Backpressure (proposed to Fable2 17:45Z): in shared windows at most 3 concurrent cargo or npm builds across both projects, cold compiles one at a time, at most 2 per project, staggered; full gates strictly serial.
- Greg questions with defaults: w-b447 (a) loaded run; w-8caf default B; w-15b4 durability (1) keep the close checkpoint; WSL #1514 (criteria amended to verifiable evidence). Reserved acts still need Greg's own word: store-format change or migration, authority widening, TermAl restarts, deploy, global configuration.
